groups.saying_opens: إن أخاك عبد الله بن مسعود يقول من يقم الحول
كان أبو وائل شقيق بن سلمة لا يتكلم
مر رجل على زر بن حبيش وهو يؤذن

notes: Three reports sit in one Tirmidhi entry, each with its own isnad: separate sayings or acts (rule 4a), so three groups with saying numbers and null tail

In the third, the passer-by is scene; Zirr answers ("فقال زر"), which the rules would read as a last link (rule 6), but that surface is not written as a name here: left for review, the chain stops at Asim
«قال أبو عيسى» and «هذا حديث حسن صحيح» are the compiler's remarks, left out; in the first, Ubayy is the asked one who answers (rule 6)
